title: "State importance"
author: Casey Breen

```{r}
## set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(47)  

## library packages 
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R")) ## library all packages for analysis 

## read in death file 
death_file <- read_dta(here("data", "analysis_files", "nfhs5_deaths.DTA")) %>% 
  filter(months_since_death > 3) %>% 
  mutate(registered = as.factor(registered))

## cleam up variable 
death_file <- death_file %>% 
  mutate(facility_distance_quantile = ntile(facility_distance, n = 5)) %>% 
  mutate(road_length_km_quantile = ntile(road_length_km, n = 5))
  
death_file <- death_file %>% 
  filter(!is.na(area_km2))


death_file <- death_file %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1000) %>% 
  ungroup()

vars <- vars[vars != "state"]
```

```{r}
# Define formula
formula <- as.formula(paste("registered ~", paste(vars, collapse = " + ")))

# Define model
rf_model <- rand_forest(trees = 500, min_n = 5, mode = "classification") %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation")

# Split data
death_file_split <- initial_split(death_file, 0.75)
train <- training(death_file_split)
test  <- testing(death_file_split)

# Ensure "state" exists in dataset
if (!"state" %in% colnames(train) | !"state" %in% colnames(test)) {
  stop("The dataset must contain a 'state' column for grouping.")
}

# Function to train model and compute permutation importance per state
compute_importance_by_state <- function(state_data, state_name) {
  
  # Define recipe for preprocessing
  rf_recipe <- recipe(formula, data = state_data) %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  # Create workflow
  rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rf_model) %>%
    add_recipe(rf_recipe)

  # Train model
  rf_fit <- rf_workflow %>% fit(data = state_data)

  # Extract trained model
  model <- extract_fit_parsnip(rf_fit)

  # Define probability function
  pf <- function(m, X) {
    X_preprocessed <- bake(prep(rf_recipe), X)
    predict(m, X_preprocessed, type = "prob")$.pred_1
  }

  # Get y values
  y_test <- state_data$registered
  y_test <- as.numeric(as.character(y_test))

  # Compute permutation importance
  imp <- perm_importance(
    model, X = state_data, y = y_test, v = vars, pred_fun = pf, loss = "squared_error"
  )

  # Convert importance list to dataframe
  imp_df <- data.frame(value = imp[[1]]) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") %>%
    bind_cols(data.frame(se = imp[[2]])) %>% 
    mutate(state = state_name)

  return(imp_df)
}
```

```{r}
# Compute permutation importance for each state separately
test <- test %>%
  mutate(state = as_factor(state)) 

state_importance_data <- test %>%
  group_split(state) %>%
  set_names(unique(test$state)) %>%
  map2_dfr(.x = ., .y = names(.), .f = compute_importance_by_state)

# Rename variable names
state_importance_data <- state_importance_data %>%
  clean_varnames(Variable)

# Normalize importance within each state and reorder variables descending
state_importance_data_norm <- state_importance_data %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  mutate(
    value = value / max(value),
    se = se / max(value)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Generate combined plot with facets for each state
state_importance_plot <- ggplot(state_importance_data_norm, aes(x = value, y = reorder(var_clean, value))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E84C4") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = value - se, xmax = value + se), height = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ state, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  labs(title = "Permutation Importance by State",
       x = "Relative Importance",
       y = "Variable") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))


# Generate combined plot with facets for each state
var_importance_plot_state <- ggplot(state_importance_data_norm, aes(x = value, y = reorder(state, value))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E84C4") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = value - se, xmax = value + se), height = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~var_clean, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  labs(title = "Permutation Importance by State",
       x = "Relative Importance",
       y = "Variable") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

## save figures 
ggsave(var_importance_plot_state, filename = here("figures", "var_importance_var_facet.png"), height = 20, width= 20, bg = "white") 
ggsave(state_importance_plot, filename = here("figures", "var_importance_state_facet.png"), height = 20, width= 20, bg = "white") 
```
